notes.t120: Board wiring from the stock T120 firmware dump (led_blink.sh gpio73=PC9; motor.ko maxstep=5300,1100; audio.ko spk_gpio=-1 so no speaker) and the T41NQ stock DTB (power key GPA30; msc0 cd-gpios GPB26 active-low + cd-inverted; mmc0_pwrseq reset GPB29). SD power is active-low: gpio clear 61 + mmc rescan is bench-confirmed on the T41NQ. Motor phase pins and calibration are adopted from the validated Noorio T110 profile; both cameras share the same motor.ko maxstep values, but pan/tilt direction still needs a bench check. WiFi REGON pin 60 is adopted from the T110; the T120 stock failure path toggles gpio57, so verify before relying on it.
